snippet.title: Madvent Calendar 3 : Necrosis | Day 25 - Merry Crisis | Full Game Playthrough | No Commentary
snippet.description:
Day 25 of Madvent Calendar 3, Merry Crisis Game Playthrough without Audio Commentary. 
Merry Christmas Everyone :)

Madvent Calendar 3 is basically an advent calendar but for games created by 'The Haunted ps1'.  However instead of the usual 24/25 days, there is a  total of 30 days hence 30 games to play. I will be releasing each days game on the specific day however these days may be different for you due to time difference and I am starting a day late so two uploads on the first day :)  

Game : https://hauntedps1.itch.io/madvent3

A mainly horror playthrough gaming channel without any audio commentary focusing on gameplay, however in order to add 'personality' and a form of uniqueness they have been slightly edited. 

Loading screens, empty screens, getting lost, 'aimless' wandering not adding to the experience, idle time in menus & deaths have been edited out to provide a better viewing experience where viewers can immerse themselves in experiencing the storyline.

Thank you for watching
